rationale: Description: bend arms on hips with elbows pushed behind back to emphasize hourglass. Per CORRECTED convention, shoulderFwd + = BEHIND. Both shoulderFwdL/R were -15 (arms forward) — sign inverted. Increased to +40/+45 to push elbows behind. Increased elbow flexion to 140/145 to bring forearms back to hips. Reduced shoulder abduction (40/52 → 10/15) for less splayed arms. Flipped hipAbductR -15 → +25 to adduct (cross) bent knee inward per description. wristL_to_hipL improved 0.579→0.256 (borderline <0.25); wristR_to_hipR improved 0.610→0.219 (achieves contact).
